THE WEIGHTS AND MEASURES OF CAPACITY ACT, 1871
THE WEIGHTS AND
MEASURES OF CAPACITY ACT, 1871.
Act No. XXXI of
1871
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1871, Pt. V p. 398; for
Proceedings in Council, see ibid., 1871, Supplement, pp. 1181, 1290, 142 and 1575.
This Act has been repealed, in so far as it relates to the
establishment of Standards of Weight, by the Standards of Weight Act, 1939 (9
of 1939), s. 6.
It has been rep. in its application to the Bombay Presidency,
by the Bom bay Weights and Measures Act, 1932 (Bom. Act 15 of 1932). When Part
VI of the Punjab Weights and Measures Act, 1941 (Punjab Act 12 of 1941) is
brought into force in any area of the Punjab, this Act (31 of 1871) will be
deemed to have been repealed in its application to that area, see Punjab Act 12
of 1941, s. 40.
It shall be deemed to have been repealed in the N: W. F. P.,
when Part V of the N:- W. F. P. Weights and Measures Act, 1947 (N: W. F. P. Act
23 of 1947) comes into force in that Province. See s. 42 of that Act.)
[30th October, 1871]
An Act to regulate the Weights and Measures of
Capacity of 2[Pakistan].
( Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960
(21 of 1960), S. 3 and 2nd Sch.(with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for
the Provinces and the Capital of the Federation " which was subs. for
" British India " by A. O.,1949, Arts. 3(2) and 4.)
I ‑PRELIMINARY
1.Short title and Local
Extent:--- This Act may the called the (The word
"Indian" rep. by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration) Act,
1951 (26 of 1951), S. 3 and II Sch.) Weights and Measures of ; Capacity
Act, 1871, and extends to (Subs by Ordinance 21 of
1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for "
all the Provinces and the Capital of the Federation which was subs. for "
the whole of British India " by A. O., 1949, Arts. 3(2) and 4.) [the
whole of Pakistan].

11. Power to make rules:---- The
(See foot‑note 1, on preceding page.)
[Central Government] may, from time to time, make rules consistent with this Act
for regulating the following matters :‑
(a) the appointment of Wardens ;
(b) the guidance of Wardens in
all matters connected with the performance of their duties;
(c) the provision, replacement,
custody and use of the standards ;
(d) the method of verifying local
standards and weights, weighing machines and measures of capacity authorized
under this Act, and balances, and of certifying such verification ;
provided that such verification
shall not be required to be made oftener than once in two years ;
(e) the errors which may be
tolerated in weights, weighing machines and measures of capacity authorized
under this Act, and in balances ;
(f) the shapes, proportions and
dimensions to b given to weights, weighing machines and measures of capacity
authorized under this Act, and to balances, and. the materials of which they
may be made ;
(g) marking weights and measures
of capacity authorized under this Act with their several denominations ;
(h) the conditions under which
Government offices, muni cipal bodies and railway companies shall be subject to
inspection and verification of the weights, weighing
machines and measures of capacity
authorized under this Act, and of the balances used by them ;
(i) the fees to be paid for
verifying, correcting and certifying the verification of weights, weighing
machines and measures of capacity authorized under this Act, and of balances.
